# Abhimanue Udayan

> Official website of Abhimanue Udayan — Study Coach, Educator, Entrepreneur, and Founder of Hexagon Know. Study performance coaching, learn-how-to-learn training, NEET/JEE/UPSC preparation guidance, and Physics coaching for school and competitive exam students.

## Programs & Coaching

- [Study Performance Coaching](https://abhimanue.in/study-performance-coaching.html): Personalized coaching to improve memory, focus, study habits, and subject mastery with an AI-powered learning platform.
- [A Level Physics Coaching](https://abhimanue.in/A-Level-Physics.html): 1-to-1 online coaching for Cambridge and Edexcel A Level Physics.
- [NEET Physics Academy](https://abhimanue.in/neet-physics-academy.html): Structured NEET Physics preparation program.
- [NEET Physics Crash Course](https://abhimanue.in/neet-physics-crash-course.html): Intensive crash course for NEET Physics.
- [NEET Crash Course 2026](https://abhimanue.in/neet-crash-course-2026.html): Crash course for NEET 2026 aspirants.
- [Foundation Academy](https://abhimanue.in/foundation-academy.html): Foundation program for school students.
- [Learn With Abhimanue](https://abhimanue.in/learn-with-abhimanue.html): Learn-how-to-learn program.
